title: Senior Architect
description:
1\. POSITION PURPOSE

The Senior Architect will provide senior\-level architectural leadership and project ownership across multiple projects, from conceptualization and design development through detailed documentation, coordination, and construction support.

The position is responsible for ensuring design excellence, technical quality, statutory compliance, timely project delivery, client satisfaction, and effective team performance.

The Senior Architect will act as a key link between the Lead/Principal Architect, design team, consultants, project team, clients, contractors, and statutory authorities.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Design Leadership \& Architectural Development

Lead the architectural design process from concept stage through detailed design and execution.

Develop and review design concepts, planning strategies, space planning, elevations, sections, details, and presentations.

Translate client requirements, project objectives, and functional requirements into effective architectural solutions.

Provide strategic design direction to Architects and Junior Architects.

Review design alternatives and recommend practical, economical, and technically feasible solutions.

Maintain the architectural vision and design intent throughout the project lifecycle.

Ensure consistency of design quality across multiple projects.

Take responsibility for resolving complex architectural and design challenges.

B. Project Ownership \& Delivery

Take overall responsibility for assigned architectural projects and deliverables.

Establish project design priorities, deliverables, and internal timelines.

Monitor progress against project schedules and ensure timely submission of deliverables.

Identify potential delays, design risks, coordination issues, and resource requirements at an early stage.

Coordinate with the Project Head to ensure architectural activities remain aligned with overall project objectives.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and deadlines.

Ensure proper handover and continuity between design, documentation, and site execution stages.

C. Client Management \& Stakeholder Coordination

Act as a senior point of contact for clients on architectural matters.

Understand and evaluate client requirements and provide professional recommendations.

Lead design presentations and client review meetings.

Manage client feedback, design revisions, and approvals.

Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, PMC teams, and government authorities.

Represent the organization in important project meetings when delegated by the Lead/Principal Architect.

Handle sensitive design, coordination, and project\-related discussions professionally.

D. Multidisciplinary Coordination

Lead coordination with Structural, Electrical, HVAC/MEP, Landscape, Interior, Fire \& Safety, and other specialist consultants.

Review multidisciplinary drawings and identify clashes, discrepancies, and design conflicts.

Ensure architectural requirements are properly incorporated into other consultants' designs.

Coordinate with estimation and project teams for design\-related requirements.

Provide timely architectural inputs to the Project and Estimation teams.

Participate in technical coordination meetings and ensure closure of outstanding issues.

E. Technical Review \& Quality Control

Conduct detailed technical reviews of architectural drawings and documentation.

Review working drawings, construction details, schedules, specifications, and material proposals.

Ensure drawings are technically accurate, coordinated, and suitable for construction.

Establish and maintain architectural documentation and quality standards.

Review drawings prepared by Architects and Draftsmen before submission/issuance.

Ensure compliance with applicable NBC, local development regulations, building bye\-laws, fire regulations, accessibility standards, and statutory requirements.

Identify design and documentation errors before issue to clients, consultants, or contractors.

F. Construction \& Site Support

Provide senior\-level architectural guidance during construction.

Conduct regular site visits as required by project requirements.

Review site conditions and provide appropriate architectural solutions.

Resolve technical queries raised by contractors and site teams.

Review shop drawings, material samples, mock\-ups, and construction details.

Monitor execution against approved architectural drawings and design intent.

Coordinate with the Project/Site Team for timely resolution of architectural issues.

Provide recommendations on variations, substitutions, and design modifications where required.

G. Team Leadership \& Resource Management

Lead, supervise, and mentor Architects, Junior Architects, Intern Architects, and Draftsmen.

Allocate work according to project requirements, individual capabilities, and deadlines.

Review team performance and deliverables at regular intervals.

Provide technical guidance and develop the capabilities of junior team members.

Establish efficient workflows for design development and documentation.

Monitor team workload and coordinate resource requirements with management.

Promote accountability, collaboration, and professional standards within the architecture team.

Conduct knowledge\-sharing and technical review sessions where required.

H. Design Standards \& Process Development

Develop and maintain standardized architectural drawing and documentation practices.

Improve internal design, coordination, and review processes.

Establish checklists for design and drawing quality control.

Ensure proper version control and documentation of design revisions.

Introduce efficient methods to improve productivity and reduce design/documentation errors.

Support management in developing architectural standards and internal design guidelines.

I. Commercial \& Project Coordination Support

Provide architectural inputs for project estimates, BOQs, specifications, and tender documentation.

Coordinate with the Commercial/Estimation Team regarding design changes and their cost implications.

Review scope changes and provide technical inputs for variation proposals.

Support management in evaluating design options from technical, functional, quality, and cost perspectives.

Assist in preparing technical proposals and presentations for new projects and tenders when required.

J. Business Development \& Pre\-Tender Support

Support the Lead/Principal Architect in architectural proposals, tenders, EOIs, and presentations.

Contribute to project feasibility studies and preliminary design proposals.

Assist in preparing design narratives, project presentations, and technical submissions.

Participate in client presentations and pre\-bid discussions when required.

Provide professional inputs for developing new project opportunities.

3\. AUTHORITY \& DECISION\-MAKING

The Senior Architect will be expected to:

Take ownership of architectural decisions within assigned projects.

Approve/recommend design and technical solutions within delegated authority.

Review and recommend architectural drawings before final approval.

Allocate and monitor work within the architecture team.

Escalate major design, commercial, contractual, or project risks to the Lead/Principal Architect.

Ensure that critical architectural decisions are properly documented and communicated.

Take responsibility for the quality and timely completion of assigned architectural deliverables.

4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

Timely delivery of architectural milestones and deliverables.

Quality and accuracy of architectural drawings and documentation.

Effective multidisciplinary coordination.

Successful resolution of design and site\-related issues.

Client satisfaction and quality of client communication.

Team productivity and performance.

Effective management of multiple projects.

Reduction in drawing errors, rework, and coordination issues.

Compliance with statutory requirements and project standards.

Contribution to project profitability, efficiency, and successful delivery.

Development and mentoring of the architecture team.

5\. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Educational Qualification

B.Arch. – Bachelor of Architecture from a recognized institution.

M.Arch. / specialization in Architecture, Urban Design, or related field will be an advantage.

Professional Registration

Council of Architecture (COA) registration preferred/required as applicable.

Experience

15–20 years of relevant professional experience in architectural design and project delivery.

Proven experience in independently handling medium to large\-scale projects.

Experience in government, institutional, commercial, residential, infrastructure, or public\-sector projects will be an advantage.

6\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES

Technical

Advanced knowledge of architectural planning and design.

Strong understanding of building construction and detailing.

Knowledge of statutory regulations and approval processes.

Strong multidisciplinary coordination skills.

Excellent understanding of construction documentation and site execution.

Leadership

Strong team leadership and people\-management skills.

Ability to mentor and develop architects and junior team members.

Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving abilities.

Ability to manage priorities and multiple projects.

Client \& Communication

Excellent verbal and written communication.

Strong presentation and client\-handling skills.

Ability to confidently communicate technical matters to non\-technical stakeholders.

Strong negotiation and coordination skills.

Software

AutoCAD

Revit/BIM

SketchUp

Adobe Creative Suite

MS Office

Other relevant architectural/design software

7\. EXPECTED PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES

The Senior Architect should demonstrate:

Ownership \& Accountability

Leadership \& Team Development

Design Excellence

Technical Competence

Client Orientation

Strategic Thinking

Problem Solving

Attention to Detail

Time \& Project Management

Professional Integrity

Collaborative Working Style

8\. ROLE EXPECTATION

The Senior Architect is expected to function not merely as a design professional but as a project and design leader, capable of independently managing architectural responsibilities, guiding the architecture team, coordinating multidisciplinary consultants, handling senior\-level client interactions, and ensuring successful delivery of projects in line with the organization's quality, design, commercial, and timeline objectives.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: PEB Structural Engineer
description:
Vardan is looking for an experienced **PEB Structural Engineer** with **10\+ years of experience** in structural design and engineering of **Pre\-Engineered Buildings (PEB) and structural steel projects**.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **structural analysis, PEB design, steel structures, engineering drawings, technical coordination, fabrication, and site execution**, with a proven ability to handle projects from design through execution.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and analyze **PEB and structural steel structures** as per applicable IS Codes and engineering standards.
* Prepare and review **structural calculations, GA drawings, fabrication drawings, and erection drawings**.
* Perform structural analysis and design using **STAAD.Pro, Tekla Structures, AutoCAD**, and related software.
* Review structural designs for **strength, stability, safety, serviceability, and cost optimization**.
* Coordinate with **architects, consultants, clients, fabricators, and project execution teams**.
* Review shop drawings, fabrication details, connection details, and erection requirements.
* Provide technical support to **fabrication and site teams** and resolve structural issues.
* Conduct site visits to ensure execution is in accordance with approved structural drawings.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams for structural material requirements.
* Monitor engineering deliverables and support timely project execution.
* Ensure compliance with **IS Codes, quality standards, and safety requirements**.
* Identify opportunities for **structural optimization and material cost reduction**.
* Prepare technical reports, design documentation, and project progress updates.
* Manage multiple structural/PEB projects and ensure timely completion.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* Bachelor's Degree in **Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering**.
* **10\+ years of relevant experience** in PEB and structural steel engineering.
* Strong knowledge of **PEB design and structural steel design**.
* Proficiency in:
* **STAAD.Pro**
* **Tekla Structures**
* **AutoCAD**
* **MS Office**
* Strong understanding of **IS Codes, structural analysis, steel connections, fabrication, and erection**.
* Good knowledge of structural design principles and engineering practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication and coordination abilities.

Preferred Experience

Experience in **industrial buildings, warehouses, factories, commercial buildings, and large\-scale PEB/structural steel projects** will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a technically strong professional who can **independently handle structural design, coordinate with project stakeholders, support fabrication and site execution, and deliver safe, economical, and efficient structural solutions.**

Why Join Vardan?

* Opportunity to work on **large\-scale PEB and structural steel projects**.
* Exposure to challenging engineering and construction projects.
* Professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative and performance\-driven work environment.
* Competitive salary and benefits.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

title: APM-Interiors
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Asst. Project Manager \- Corporate InteriorsJLL Project \& Development Services (PDS) \| Gujarat, IndiaAbout JLLJones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our Project \& Development Services (PDS) team delivers comprehensive project and program management services across diverse industries and geographies.
  
Position OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead corporate interior projects across Gujarat. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities who can manage end\-to\-end project delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and client satisfaction.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesProject Planning \& Execution
  
The Project Manager will oversee all phases of corporate interior projects from initiation through closeout. You will develop comprehensive project plans, establish timelines and milestones, coordinate design development with architects and consultants, and ensure alignment with client objectives and brand standards. Managing project scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters while anticipating and mitigating risks will be central to your role.
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, you will build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders including client representatives, design consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal JLL teams. You will conduct regular progress meetings, provide transparent communication on project status, and manage expectations effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Financial \& Contract Management
  
You will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates and budget forecasts, monitoring project expenditures and cash flows, reviewing and approving contractor invoices and change orders, and ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets. Administering contracts and ensuring compliance with terms and conditions will be essential aspects of this role.
  
Quality \& Compliance
  
Ensuring that all work meets JLL quality standards and client specifications is paramount. You will conduct regular site inspections and quality audits, verify compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and statutory requirements, coordinate testing and commissioning activities, and manage the punch list and defect rectification process.
  
Team Leadership
  
You will lead project teams including consultants, contractors, and JLL staff members. Building collaborative working relationships, providing clear direction and guidance, monitoring team performance, and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability will be key leadership responsibilities.
  
Required QualificationsEducation \& Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required. A minimum of 8\-12 years of experience in project management with specific focus on corporate interiors, office fit\-outs, or commercial projects is essential. Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple projects simultaneously in the Gujarat region is highly preferred.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Strong knowledge of interior construction methodologies, materials, and finishes is required. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent software, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) is expected. Thorough understanding of building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards applicable to commercial interiors is necessary. Familiarity with MEP systems coordination and integration within interior spaces is valued.
  
Professional Skills
  
Excellent communication and presentation abilities in English and Hindi (Gujarati is advantageous) are required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities, along with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, are essential. Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, cost control, and forecasting is necessary. Client\-focused mindset with commitment to service excellence is fundamental to success in this role.
  
Preferred QualificationsPMP or equivalent project management certification demonstrates professional commitment. Experience working with multinational corporations or large\-scale corporate clients is valuable. Knowledge of sustainable building practices and LEED/IGBC certification processes is beneficial. Exposure to design\-build or integrated project delivery methods is advantageous.
  
What We OfferOpportunity to work with leading multinational and domestic corporate clients on prestigious interior projects. Collaborative work environment with experienced professionals committed to excellence. Professional development opportunities including training programs and certifications. Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Exposure to diverse project types across various industry sectors.
  
LocationGujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar preferred, with willingness to travel across Gujarat as needed)
  
JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
  
To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative for application procedures.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
